groups.title: Recent 90-Day Dynamics
groups.description: Velocity and recency metrics within the immediate 90-day window before observation date

groups.title: Order Cadence & Frequency
groups.description: Lifetime transaction frequency, inter-order intervals, and item volume

groups.title: Spend & Basket Economics
groups.description: Cumulative monetary spend, median basket size, and freight proportions

groups.title: Geography & Merchant Engagement

features.name: recency_days
features.label: Recency (Days Since Last Order)
features.description: Calendar days elapsed since customer placed their most recent order (max 180 days in lookback window).

features.name: orders_recent_90d
features.label: Orders in Recent 90 Days
features.description: Count of qualifying orders placed within the immediate 90-day observation window.

features.name: spend_recent_90d
features.label: Spend in Recent 90 Days
features.description: Gross merchandise value purchased during the immediate 90-day observation window.

features.name: spend_ratio_recent_vs_earlier
features.label: Spend Ratio (Recent vs Earlier)
features.description: Proportion of lifetime spend that occurred within recent 90 days vs earlier lifecycle (1.0 = all spend was recent).

features.name: order_ratio_recent_vs_earlier
features.label: Order Ratio (Recent vs Earlier)
features.description: Proportion of lifetime orders placed within recent 90 days vs earlier lifecycle.

features.name: order_count
features.label: Total Historical Orders
features.description: Total lifetime orders completed by the customer within the 180-day lookback window.

features.name: has_multiple_orders
features.label: Multi-Order Customer Flag
features.description: 1 if the customer has placed 2 or more orders, 0 if single-order buyer.

features.name: total_items
features.label: Total Items Purchased
features.description: Total quantity of physical merchandise items across all lifetime orders.

features.name: avg_items_per_order
features.label: Avg Items Per Order
features.description: Mean merchandise item density per order.

features.name: distinct_products
features.label: Distinct Products (SKUs)
features.description: Number of distinct product catalog items ordered by the customer.

features.name: tenure_days
features.label: Customer Account Tenure
features.description: Calendar days elapsed since customer placed their first order in the lookback window.

features.name: avg_inter_order_days
features.label: Avg Inter-Order Cadence
features.description: Mean days elapsed between consecutive orders (defaults to 180.0 for single-order buyers).

features.name: std_inter_order_days
features.label: Inter-Order Interval Std Dev
features.description: Standard deviation of inter-order interval (0.0 for buyers with fewer than 3 orders).

features.name: total_spend
features.label: Total Lifetime Spend
features.description: Gross expenditure (including item price and freight) across all orders.

features.name: avg_order_value
features.label: Average Order Value (AOV)
features.description: Mean monetary value per order.

features.name: median_order_value
features.label: Median Order Value
features.description: Median monetary value per order (robust against high-value single items).

features.name: order_value_std
features.label: Order Value Std Dev
features.description: Standard deviation of order values across orders (0.0 for single-order buyers).

features.name: total_freight
features.label: Total Freight Paid
features.description: Cumulative shipping charges across all customer orders.

features.name: freight_ratio
features.label: Freight to Total Spend Ratio
features.description: Proportion of gross customer spend allocated to logistics rather than product value.

features.name: customer_state
features.label: Customer State (UF)
features.description: Federative unit / state of customer delivery address.

features.name: distinct_sellers
features.label: Distinct Sellers Engaged
features.description: Number of distinct merchants fulfilled orders for this customer.

presets.name: Hypothetical: Active Multi-Order Customer
presets.description: Customer with 3 orders, recent purchase in last 15 days, expanding spend momentum.

presets.name: Hypothetical: Lapsed At-Risk Buyer
presets.description: Single order placed 165 days ago, zero activity in recent 90 days.

presets.name: Hypothetical: Typical Median Customer
presets.description: Direct median features across the 130k Olist customer snapshots.
